topic: A person learns their apartment building is going condo
text: The rain's been coming down in sheets, mixing with the grime on the sidewalks. I'm sittin' in my office, the city outside lookin' like it's been painted in shades of grey. Got a call this mornin' from a lady, voice all tight and nervous. Seems her apartment building is going condo. She's worried, and who can blame her? People like her don't get many choices around here. They tell her it’s progress, but progress has a funny way of smelling like bleach and sounding like the clink of champagne glasses in a room where she'll never be invited. I told her I'd look into it, maybe find a way to slow things down, give her some time to figure out her next move. Gonna need to talk to a few people, see what’s really cooking behind the facades. This city, it's got more secrets than a locked safe. But I know how to find the right combination.
